name: kosmodrom
description: Kosmodrom task tracker in ChatGPT: work queue, tasks, bugs, features, team chats and worklogs through the Kosmodrom MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
Kosmodrom is a task tracker for product teams. With this plugin ChatGPT works in your Kosmodrom workspace on your behalf: it shows your work queue and task cards, finds tasks, bugs and features, reads specifications, relations, team chats, worklogs and the code context of tasks, creates tasks and bugs, moves tasks through their workflow, posts to team chats and keeps agent memory notes.

Who it is for: product managers, analysts, developers and QA engineers whose team plans and tracks work in Kosmodrom.

How it works: you sign in to Kosmodrom with OAuth and choose read-only or read and write access. ChatGPT sees only the companies, products and data your Kosmodrom account can access, and acts within your role's privileges. Your work queue and task cards are shown as interactive widgets; actions from a widget are sent back to the conversation for confirmation.

Limitations: write tools change shared team data, so ChatGPT asks before acting; deletion and version release are irreversible and happen only at your explicit request. Names, titles and texts stay in the language of your workspace. Access can be revoked at any time in your Kosmodrom profile, Sessions and access tab.
defaultPrompt: What is in my Kosmodrom work queue?
Find Kosmodrom tasks about maintenance plans.

positive.prompt: What is on my plate in Kosmodrom?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the work queue widget of the signed-in user with their tasks grouped by urgency and state, for example task #1995 "Analyze requirements and define data model for accountant access" in progress.
Shows the task card widget for #1970 "Analyse telematics event data and define score calculation requirement" with status, assignee, feature and specification, and a link to the task in Kosmodrom.

positive.prompt: Find FleetPulse tasks about maintenance plans.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists matching tasks of the FleetPulse Web dashboard product, including #1103 "Implement maintenance plan trigger logic", with links.

positive.prompt: Log a bug in the FleetPulse Web dashboard: the driver score page shows an empty chart for new drivers.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm the bug title and description, then creates the bug as a draft in a matching feature and returns its key and link.

positive.prompt: How much time did the team log in Kosmodrom this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes this week's worklogs the user can see, with totals by person and task, without inventing entries.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Berlin for Monday.
Show me the tasks of another company I am not a member of.

review.commerce_description: Kosmodrom does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: work queue and task card widgets, task, bug and feature search and context, task creation and workflow transitions, team chats, worklogs and agent memory.
